question:
The following bar chart shows the runs scored and the balls played by a batsman in 5 different innings.

Strike rate = frac{{Runs scored}}{{Balls played}} times 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3da02c138aaca6726ff5261a2119de071ede5270d37b4fab52259655b84e4743.png] 

What is the difference between the strike rates of I2 and I5? [Give your answer correct to 2 decimal places.]
solution:
**Calculation:**

According to the question:

⇒ I2 = 102/66 × 100 = 154.54

⇒ I5 = 56/44 × 100 = 127.27

Difference between I2 & I5

⇒ 154.54 - 127.27

⇒ 27.27

**∴ Option 4 is the correct answer.**
